statement: CLOSED result requires accountable closure evidence.
Overdue/escalated obligation is never equivalent to completed follow-up.
AI/system cannot promote recommendation to DECIDED/SIGNED clinical authority.
Non-COMPUTED state cannot carry a normal/reassuring clinical value.
High-impact AI requires envelope, evidence, human authority and kill switch.
Critical reconciliation cannot execute without accountable owner.
Corrected result requires monotonic supersession lineage and replay/impact traceability.
Unsupported applicability context must block clinically consequential computation.

A prescription barrier that could not be evaluated is never presented or persisted as PASSED, and a verdict with NOT_EVALUATED barriers is never CLEAR; prescribing then requires explicit acknowledgement with justification.

A BLOCKED overridable barrier is lifted only by naming that barrier with a clinical justification recorded with the prescriber; naming a non-blocking barrier is rejected; hard barriers are never lifted.
A computed daily dose above the absolute ceiling, or above the pediatric mg/kg/day maximum, is BLOCKED and cannot be overridden.
PRESCRIBE and clinical signature require PHYSICIAN authority and registered professional credentials; the legal identity is persisted with the act.

Every request executes only with a verified session whose tenant matches, a mandatory scope and the declared purpose; every database access runs under the tenant's RLS context (NOBYPASSRLS role); cross-tenant access fails closed.
A clinical command is either fully committed (event, idempotency record, audit entry, outbox message) or not at all; an unavailable store yields DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, never a reported success.
Audit chain entries are append-only and each stored hash is recomputable from the persisted entry and its predecessor; any alteration is detectable.
